map.制造业经典阈值：Z≥2.99 安全区，1.81–2.99 灰色区，<1.81 危: Classic manufacturing thresholds: Z >= 2.99 is the safe zone, 1.81-2.99 the grey zone, and below 1.81 the danger zone. Non-manufacturing sectors can refer to adjusted models; these thresholds are empirical values, not legal standards.
map.基于历史财报，对新兴、轻资产公司区分度下降；X₄（权益市值/负债）在市场剧烈波动: Based on historical financial statements, discrimination drops for new, asset-light companies. X4 (market value of equity / debt) is unstable when the market swings sharply, so it needs to be judged together with cash flow and the industry cycle.
map.投资者用模型筛选标的，剔除财务结构脆弱的公司。: Investors use the model to screen targets and drop companies with fragile financial structures.
map.构建企业财务风险评估模型，输入负债、现金流与盈利等指标，输出风险等级与预警信号，: Builds a corporate financial risk assessment model: enter indicators such as debt, cash flow and profitability to get a risk grade and early warning signals. Suitable for credit review, internal control health checks and operational risk screening.

map.风险（预警/评估/应对）模型 使用指南: Risk (early warning / assess / respond) model guide
map.：某制造企业 X₁=营运资本/总资产=0.15、X₂=留存收益/总资产=0.20: : a manufacturing company has X1 = working capital / total assets = 0.15, X2 = retained earnings / total assets = 0.20, X3 = EBIT / total assets = 0.12, X4 = market value of equity / total liabilities = 1.0 and X5 = sales revenue / total assets = 1.2, so Z = 1.2x0.15 + 1.4x0.20 + 3.3x0.12 + 0.6x1.0 + 1.0x1.2 = 0.18 + 0.28 + 0.396 + 0.6 + 1.2 = 2.656, which falls in the 1.81-2.99 grey zone and needs attention.
